           Chinese Weekly Influenza Surveillance Report
                        October 12 to October 18, 2026 (Week 42)
       (All data are preliminary and may change as more reports are received)

Summary
    The positive rate of influenza virus testing increased slightly in southern and
     northern provinces, with A(H3N2) dominated. There were 28 ILI outbreaks
     reported in this week.
    Among influenza viruses antigenically characterized by CNIC since March 30,
     2026, 72(94.7%) influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses were characterized as
     A/Missouri/11/2025-like;         355(82.6%)       influenza     A(H3N2)     viruses     were
     characterized      as    A/Darwin/1454/2025(egg)-like,             387(90.0%)    influenza
     A(H3N2)viruses          were     characterized      as      A/Darwin/1415/2025(cell)-like;
     605(93.7%)        influenza      B/Victoria       viruses      were     characterized     as
     B/Tokyo/EIS13-175/2025-like.
    Among the influenza viruses tested by CNIC for antiviral resistance analysis
     since March 30, 2026, all A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses were sensitive to
     neuraminidase inhibitors, all but 1 A(H3N2) and 2 B/Victoria viruses were
     sensitive to neuraminidase inhibitors; all A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2) and
     B/Victoria viruses were sensitive to influenza polymerase inhibitors.


Surveillance of outpatient or emergency visits for Influenza-like Illness (ILI)
     During week 42, the percentage of outpatient or emergency visits for ILI (ILI%)
at national sentinel hospitals in southern provinces was 4.5%, lower than last week
(4.6%), lower than the same week of 2023(5.3%), higher than the same week of 2024
and 2025 (3.3% and 3.8%). (Figure 1)

     During week 42, ILI% at national sentinel hospitals in northern provinces was
2.8%, lower than last week (3.0%), lower than the same week of 2023 and 2024
(3.6% and 3.4%), the same as the same week of2025(2.8%).(Figure 2)

Virologic Surveillance


     During week in 42 of 2026, influenza network laboratories tested 20287
pecimens, there were 2454 positive detections for influenza. The number and
proportion of influenza types and subtypes detected in southern and northern
provinces were shown in Table1.

Antigenic Characterization
     Since March 30, 2026, 72(94.7%) influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses were
characterized as A/Missouri/11/2025-like; 355(82.6%) influenza A(H3N2) viruses
were characterized as A/Darwin/1454/2025(egg)-like, 387(90.0%) influenza A(H3N2)
viruses were characterized as A/Darwin/1415/2025(cell)-like;                 605(93.7%) influenza
B/Victoria viruses were characterized as B/Tokyo/EIS13-175/2025-like.

Antiviral Resistance
     Since March 30, 2026, among the influenza viruses tested by CNIC for antiviral
resistance, all A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses were sensitive to neuraminidase inhibitors, all
but 1 A(H3N2) and 2 B/Victoria viruses were sensitive to neuraminidase inhibitors;
all A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2) and B/Victoria viruses were sensitive to influenza
polymerase inhibitors.


Outbreak Surveillance
     During week 42, there were 28 ILI outbreaks reported nationwide. Among them,
7 were A(H3N2), 8 were A(H1N1)pdm09, 1 was B/Victoria, 6 were mixed, 6 had not
obtained the testing results.
